record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: distances between homotopy classes of H^1 maps S^2 to S^2
record.original_question: For H^1 maps from S^2 to S^2, let E_d be the homotopy class of maps of degree d, and define Dist_{H^1}(E_{d1},E_{d2}) = sup_{f in E_{d1}} inf_{g in E_{d2}} ||grad(f-g)||_{L^2}. Is Dist_{H^1}(E_{d1},E_{d2})^2 = 8 pi |d1-d2| for all integers d1,d2? Even more basically, is Dist_{H^1}(E_{d1},E_{d2}) symmetric in d1 and d2 for all integers d1,d2?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.9 ([27]). Is it true that Dist^2_{H^1}(E_{d1},E_{d2}) = 8 pi |d1-d2| for all d1,d2 in Z?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^2$ denote the standard 2-sphere. Consider the Sobolev space $H^1(S^2;S^2)$ of maps $f:S^2\to S^2$ with $\int_{S^2}|\nabla f|^2\,d\mathrm{vol}<\infty$. For each integer $d\in\mathbb{Z}$, let $E_d\subset H^1(S^2;S^2)$ denote the homotopy class consisting of maps of (Brouwer) degree $d$ (the degree being well-defined on $H^1(S^2;S^2)$). Define the asymmetric distance
$$\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2}) \;=\; \sup_{f\in E_{d_1}}\,\inf_{g\in E_{d_2}}\,\|\nabla(f-g)\|_{L^2(S^2)}.$$
Answer the following:
(a) Is it true that
$$\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})^2 \;=\; 8\pi\,|d_1-d_2|$$
for all integers $d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}$?
(b) More basically, is $\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})$ symmetric in $d_1$ and $d_2$ for all $d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on distances between homotopy classes of sphere-valued Sobolev maps (Brezis–Mironescu–Shafrir and related works). Searches turn up papers studying this asymmetric distance for $W^{s,p}(S^N;S^N)$, but no result establishing the equality $\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}^2 = 8\pi|d_1-d_2|$ or even the symmetry of the distance for $H^1(S^2;S^2)$ appears to be available; the problem is treated as open.

status_evidence.title: Distances between classes of sphere-valued Sobolev maps
status_evidence.snippet: Studies distances between homotopy classes of sphere-valued Sobolev maps; W^{1,p}(S^2,S^2) results known only for p>2 where the distance is a universal positive constant.
status_evidence.claim: The critical exponent case (H^1 = W^{1,2} for S^2 to S^2) is not resolved by these results.

status_evidence.title: Distances between homotopy classes of W^{s,p}(S^N;S^N)
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates Dist asymmetry and explicit values in W^{s,p}; the borderline (critical) case for H^1(S^2;S^2) is left open.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture Dist_{H^1}^2 = 8π|d_1-d_2| and the symmetry question for H^1(S^2;S^2) remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the distance between homotopy classes of maps between spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses distances between homotopy classes for sphere maps in Sobolev classes.
status_evidence.claim: The H^1(S^2;S^2) critical case conjecture is not established.
